_comment: Design tokens for {{PROJECT_NAME}}. Source of truth for the theme.
JSON rather than YAML because this is what design tools export: Token
Studio, Style Dictionary and the Figma API all emit JSON, so an export
can be dropped in without a conversion step.
Colours accept #RGB, #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB. A bare string means the same
value in both modes; an object with light and dark themes it.
The roles under color are not arbitrary: primary, on_primary, secondary,
on_secondary, surface, on_surface, error and on_error map onto Flutter's
ColorScheme. Without them stock Material widgets keep their default blue
and the token file only colours the widgets that read it directly.
typography.height is a MULTIPLE of font size, not pixels. A design tool
exporting lineHeight 24 for a 16px font means 1.5 here.
